title: Control room
loginText: For the Pilotix team only: shops, trials, payments and plans.
serverOnly: The control room runs on your server (pilotix.online/#/platform), not in the preview.
dashSub: Your shops, their trials, their payments, at a glance.
shopsSub: Each shop has its own data, its own team and its own plan.
plansSub: Each plan's price, its limits, and the menus it gives.
staffSub: Who can enter the control room, and what they can do.
settingsSub: Free trial, how shops pay you, a message to every shop.
journalSub: Every action taken here: who, when, on which shop.
demoSub: A shop full of fake orders, for interested customers to try.

roleText.owner: Everything: plans, prices, team, settings, cancelling a payment.
roleText.manager: Creates shops, records payments, suspends, changes menus.
roleText.support: Sees the shops, opens them to help, writes notes.

k.mrrHelp: The monthly price of the plans of every active (paid) shop, added up.
k.pendingHelp: They filled “Create my store” but haven’t clicked the e-mail link yet (it works for 48 hours).
k.conversionHelp: Of the stores created by sign-up in the last 90 days, how many made at least one payment.
k.overHelp: Stores above their plan (accounts, drivers or orders this month): offer them the bigger plan.

ownShopLong: Your own shop: everything included, it never stops.
demoShopLong: Demo shop (made-up data, reset every night).
openHelp: Opens the shop in a new tab as its administrator, to help it (2 hours, written in the journal).
suspendText: The shop is locked at once: its team sees a “Shop suspended” screen and its public links (landing pages, webhooks) stop answering. Its data is kept. You can reactivate it any time (a recorded payment reactivates it too).
archiveText: The shop is closed: nobody can log in any more and its links stop answering. Its data is kept and you can reactivate it.
createdText: “{{name}}” is ready. Send these login details to the owner:
createdOnce: The password is shown only once. The owner can change it in My profile › Security.

f.name: Shop name
f.ownerEmailHint: They log in with this e-mail. One e-mail can have several stores.
f.ownerPhoneHint: To send them their login on WhatsApp.
f.passwordHint: Empty = an easy-to-read password is made for you.
f.inviteNote: Pilotix e-mails the owner so they choose their own password. If they already have an account, the store is added to their stores.
f.languageHint: The language of the invitation and reminder e-mails.

pay.title: Payments
pay.voidText: For a payment typed by mistake: it stays in the history, crossed out, and no longer counts. If it was the last one, the paid period goes back.

sub.title: Subscription
sub.help: Change the plan, or extend the trial or the paid period by hand. A recorded payment extends the period by itself.
sub.own: Your own shop: everything included, it never stops.
sub.demo: The demo shop has no subscription: it never stops.

use.title: Usage
use.overOrders: Above its plan’s orders this month: offer it the bigger plan.
use.help: Numbers only, never what’s inside the store. In red: above its plan’s limit.
use.over: This store is above its plan: offer it the bigger plan. Its orders are never blocked.

menus.title: Menus and sub-menus
menus.help: Tick what this shop sees. Underlined items are this shop’s own choice (different from its plan).
menus.own: Your shop has everything. You can still hide menus.

admins.title: Administrators
admins.help: If an administrator lost their password (no email), give them a new one here.
admins.shownText: New password of {{name}} (their other sessions are closed):

info.title: Details
info.notesHint: Seen only by the Pilotix team.
info.slugWarn: Careful: links already given out (landing pages, webhooks) change with this name.

log.shopAdded: Store added by its owner ({{plan}} plan)

plan.name: Name
plan.maxOrdersHint: A guide: flagged in the control room, never blocked.
plan.systemMenus: The internal plan (your shop) always gives everything.
plan.priceYearHint: Empty = no yearly price. 12 months at the monthly price = {{price}}.

set.trialHelp: For every new shop. After the end (trial or paid period), the shop keeps access during the grace days with a red banner, then it is locked until it pays.
set.graceHint: After the end, before the lock.
set.demoHelp: A “Try the demo” button on the login page opens the demo shop.
set.demoPublic: Show “Try the demo” on the login page
set.payHelp: Shown to shops during the trial, before the end of their period and on the lock screen.
set.payTextHint: BaridiMob, CCP, beneficiary name… as you want them to read it.
set.payWaHint: The “Send on WhatsApp” button opens this number.
set.noticeHelp: A banner at the top of every shop’s app (maintenance, news…). Empty = none.
set.noticePh: e.g. Maintenance tonight from 11 pm to 11:30 pm.
set.signupHelp: Anyone can create a store from “Create my store”: the e-mail is confirmed before the store is made.
set.maxStoresHint: How many stores one person can have. You can change it for one owner on their store’s page.
set.remindHelp: Every morning at 8, Pilotix writes to owners: trial ending, subscription ending, grace period, store locked. One e-mail per step.
set.remindDays: How many days before the end
set.refHelp: Each store has a link. When a store that came with it makes its first payment, the store that brought it gets free months, automatically.
set.secHelp: At each login, a 6-digit code is e-mailed. A device can be remembered for 30 days.
set.secTwoStep: Ask for an e-mailed code at login
set.companyHelp: This is printed at the top of each payment receipt.
set.legalHelp: The page everyone accepts when creating a store. Empty = Pilotix’s standard text.
set.legalHint: Plain text, line breaks are kept.
set.legalPh: Leave empty to keep the standard text.
set.socialHelp: Paste your Google client ID here: the “Continue with Google” button then shows on the sign-in and sign-up pages. Leave empty to hide it.
set.socialGoogleHint: Google Cloud Console → Credentials → OAuth client ID “Web application”. Authorized JavaScript origin: {{site}}

demo.noneText: Create a shop filled with fake orders, products and a sample team. Interested customers can try it safely: nothing leaves it (deliveries, messages and AI are simulated).
demo.nightly: It starts again from zero every night (04:40): what visitors change disappears.
demo.publicOn: Shown on the login page: visitors pick a role and go in.
demo.publicOff: Hidden: only the Pilotix team can open the demo.

code.text: A 6-digit code was just sent to {{email}}. It works for 10 minutes.
code.label: Code from the e-mail
code.remember: Don’t ask for a code on this device for 30 days

createdInvite: “{{name}}” is created. {{email}} got an e-mail to choose a password (the link works for 7 days).
createdAdded: “{{name}}” is created and added to the Pilotix account of {{email}}: they find it when they log in, with their usual password.
createdPrivacy: You don’t know their password and you won’t see their data: only numbers (accounts, drivers, orders per month).
welcomeInvite:
Hello {{name}} 👋
Your store “{{shop}}” is ready on Pilotix.

We sent an e-mail to {{email}}: open it to choose your password (check your spam folder too).
Log in: {{url}}

Free trial: {{days}} days.
welcomeAdded:
Hello {{name}} 👋
Your new store “{{shop}}” is ready on Pilotix.

Log in as usual with {{email}}: you’ll find it in your stores.
Log in: {{url}}

Free trial: {{days}} days.

msg.sub: Messages sent by stores from “Contact Pilotix”.
msg.pickText: Pick a conversation from the list.
msg.replyHint: Your answer (the store gets it by e-mail too)

h.sub: The nightly backups and the size of each store’s data. The machine’s state is in Doctor.
h.oldBackup: The last backup is more than 30 hours old: the nightly backup may have stopped working.
h.byStoreHelp: Only the size of each store’s data, never what is inside.

owner.title: Owner
owner.help: The account that created the store. Only they see everything and can delete it. You can’t enter the store or change their password.
owner.maxStoresHint: They have {{n}}. Empty = the general setting ({{def}}).
owner.privacy: To respect their privacy, you only see numbers: you can’t enter their store or see their data. You can suspend it.

su.sub: People who create their store themselves, and how many pay afterwards.
su.summary: {{week}} this week · {{month}} this month · {{pending}} not confirmed yet.
su.pendingHelp: They filled the form but haven’t clicked the e-mailed link yet (it works for 48 hours). Nothing is made before.

ag.sub: Confirmation agencies: Pilotix checks each one before it works with stores.
ag.waiting_one: {{count}} agency is waiting for your check.
ag.waiting_other: {{count}} agencies are waiting for your check.
ag.suspendText: Its agents stop at once in every store; orders not confirmed yet go back to the stores’ teams.

mk.sub: Marketers: Pilotix checks each one before it works with stores.
mk.waiting_one: {{count}} marketer is waiting for your check.
mk.waiting_other: {{count}} marketers are waiting for your check.
mk.suspendText: Their team stops at once in every store; their ad sets stay with the stores.

designs.sub: {{n}} of {{total}} designs on. Each visit of the sign-in page shows one of them at random.
designs.keepOne: Keep at least one design on
